name: 68-z-index-stacking
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } .a { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 160px; height: 120px; background: #ff0000; z-index: 2; } .b { position: absolute; left: 80px; top: 60px; width: 160px; height: 120px; background: #0000ff; z-index: 1; } p { margin: 0; }
